justification: The construction is connected, cubic, and edge-transitive under coordinate symmetries. In the derived graphs, nonadjacent points have 0 or 2 common neighbors, whereas X(0,0) and Y(0,1) have exactly one, Z(0,0). Thus no automorphism exchanges the bipartition classes. This verifies the same semisymmetric-graph obstruction as the Folkman reference.
